svg.title: Spatial reference phases and holographic RF reception

cc:Work.dc:title: Spatial reference phases and holographic RF reception
cc:Work.dc:description: Four phase states distributed over a 4 by 4 aperture. The real incident and reference waveforms sum at element 6. Six averages of its squared RF give the highlighted heatmap row.
